sourceName: Köppen-Geiger climate classification maps (Beck et al. 2023)
attribution: Beck, H.E., McVicar, T.R., Vergopolan, N., Berg, A., Lutsko, N.J., Dufour, A., Zeng, Z., Jiang, X., van Dijk, A.I.J.M. & Miralles, D.G. (2023). High-resolution (1 km) Köppen-Geiger maps for 1901–2099 based on constrained CMIP6 projections. Scientific Data 10, 724.
transformations: Use the published 0.1° 1991–2020 GeoTIFF unchanged; no resampling or reclassification
Check the archive legend against the 30 reviewed Mundus class codes and colours
Store class values 0–30 in the blue channel of an RGB PNG (R = G = 0)
Land share per class weights each cell by its true spherical area
missingValuePolicy: 0 is water or no data and is never shown as a class. A selected point or city on a water cell takes the nearest classified cell within two cells; otherwise it has no class.
boundaryPolicy: Classes are drawn only on the Natural Earth land surface; unclassified land cells are neutral grey.

derivedAsset.encoding: RGB8: B = class value 0–30; R = G = 0
